fact: The Council of Ministers of 15 August 2026 lists among projects under way the electronic exchange of civil status entries between consular posts abroad and municipalities, and among those completed in the first half of 2026 remote requests for translation of civil status documents.
title: متابعة تقدم إنجاز مشاريع التحول الرقمي محور مجلس وزاري مضيّق
